claims.text: For \(p,c\ge1\), hence in particular for \(\min(p,c)=1\), \[ I_{j+c,i+p}\subseteq I_{j+1,i+1}. \]

The induced quotient map restricts surjectively as \[ J_{p,c}\twoheadrightarrow J_{1,1}, \] and induces a surjection \[ Q_{p,c}=J_{p,c}/\Lambda_+J_{p,c}\twoheadrightarrow J_{1,1}/\Lambda_+J_{1,1}=Q_{1,1}. \]
